records.label: Site-wide REST access policy for core and third-party routes (allow all / logged-in only / per-namespace or per-route allow and deny lists, role rules)
records.notes: miniOrange "Restrict non-logged-in users", "Selective API protection", "Disable WP REST APIs" and premium role-based authentication. Builder endpoints keep their own policy (rest-api.authz.policy); this row governs routes other plugins and core register. Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org package wp-rest-api-authentication (admin/partials/utils/class-mo-api-authentication-protected-routes.php); https://wordpress.org/plugins/wp-rest-api-authentication/

records.label: JWT tokens: login, refresh and revoke endpoints, signing key, expiry and custom header name
records.notes: miniOrange JWT authentication with token, refresh and revoke endpoints, time-based expiry and a custom header. Runs as a certified rest-api.auth.adapter; signing keys live in the secret vault and are never exported. Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org package wp-rest-api-authentication (class-mo-api-authentication-jwt-auth.php); https://wordpress.org/plugins/wp-rest-api-authentication/

records.label: Per-user API keys (hashed, scoped, expiring, revocable) with a last-used audit
records.notes: miniOrange "Universal API key and User-specific API key". WPEssential issues per-user keys only, stores a hash, shows the key once and binds it to that user's capabilities; a shared universal key stays rejected (rest-api.safety.static-bearer-default). Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org package wp-rest-api-authentication (class-mo-api-authentication-tokenapi.php); https://wordpress.org/plugins/wp-rest-api-authentication/

records.label: Accept tokens issued by an external identity provider (JWKS validation, claim-to-user mapping, optional user creation)
records.notes: miniOrange "Third Party Provider Authentication" and "Create users in WordPress based on third-party provider access tokens". Evidence: https://wordpress.org/plugins/wp-rest-api-authentication/

records.label: Ready-made endpoint presets for posts, users and WooCommerce products (list, read, create, update) built on the endpoint builder
records.notes: Advanced WP REST API ships fixed user, post and product routes behind a settings panel. WPEssential offers them as editable presets that compile to normal builder endpoints with explicit policies. Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org package advanced-wp-rest-api (apis/class-gwl-register-route-api.php); https://wordpress.org/plugins/advanced-wp-rest-api/

records.label: Export endpoints as a Postman collection
records.notes: miniOrange ships a Postman collection for its endpoints. Generated from the same schema as rest-api.docs.export. Evidence: Source audit 2026-11-20 of the wordpress.org package wp-rest-api-authentication (admin/partials/postman).

records.label: HTTP Basic auth with the account password over REST
records.notes: Rejected: miniOrange free plan offers Basic auth with the real username and password. WordPress Application Passwords (rest-api.auth.application-passwords) give the same client flow with revocable, per-app secrets. Evidence: https://wordpress.org/plugins/wp-rest-api-authentication/

records.label: Forcing every operation through POST
records.notes: Rejected: Advanced WP REST API requires POST for all calls. Endpoints keep correct HTTP methods so caches, CORS preflight and the read/write policy split stay accurate. Evidence: https://wordpress.org/plugins/advanced-wp-rest-api/

coverage.notes: Gap closure from a 2026-11-20 source and readme audit of Advanced WP REST API 1.4, WPGetAPI 2.25.5 and WordPress REST API Authentication 5.0.1.
